answer: Unrepeatable Answer Binding. Each agent identity is anchored to a seed answer it must produce to a fresh, privately issued challenge; the verifier stores only a hash of that answer, so identity creation is cheap once but re-registering the same seed is detected and rejected. Attacker cost: to field N clones, they must generate N distinct valid challenge answers, each requiring a genuine inference pass whose output cannot be copied from any mesa, leaving clone farms at a computational nadir. A comet of coordinated duplicates collapses because the binding is per-answer, not per-key.
